description:
*“I really can’t live with this guy anymore.”*

Senior Chaeyeon and junior Geon-oh are roommates who can’t agree on a single thing. Everything Geon-oh does gets on Chaeyeon’s nerves, while Geon-oh, fed up with Chaeyeon’s constant nagging, just waits for a chance to catch him slipping up.

Then one day, something that definitely shouldn’t be coming from Chaeyeon’s chest starts to… leak. He prays Geon-oh won’t notice, but his worst fear comes true when he’s caught in the act.

Only, Geon-oh’s reaction is nothing like what he expected.

*“I thought you just had some weird fetish, but this is beyond anything I imagined.  
…Should I help you with that?”*
